name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-synsbasen
title: Synsbasen
description: Danish vehicle data from Synsbasen: Motor Register, inspections, insurance, liens.

environmentVariables.name: SYNSBASEN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Synsbasen API.

environmentVariables.name: SYNSBASEN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Synsbasen API (default https://api.synsbasen.dk/v1).

environmentVariables.name: SYNSBASEN_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log. Write tools refuse to run if it cannot be written.
